title: New feedback is matched against old feedback, and a repeat is flagged
why: Owner, Nov 1 17:44 CST, forwarding a home repo session's finding: the gap is in every repo, not only home.
note: Shape (owner, Nov 1 17:57 CST: a model's meaning match, not a fixed word list): logging a feedback item has a model compare it by meaning against the repo's old inboxes, roadmap and backlog, so the owner's words match the code's names (carousel matches wheel) with no glossary to keep up; a match is flagged on the item as a repeat. Today nothing is matched. Ready: no open question. Port: yes, every repo.
